body:
Two things here, we put a default limit because it would make sense most of the time: a result page of 10 hits on 20 pages is already an impressive result list, and few people will want to read 20 pages of results (but the developer testing his implementation).

At the same time, it feels weird that there's a hidden default parameter.

So I propose that at the next major release (i.e. 2.0.0), we remove the default limit and document using 20.

We cannot do this change in a minor release, it could break people's implementations.
